Title: Log in with the built-in user
Preconditions: ParaBank is running on baseline data; user is logged out
Steps: 1) Open http://localhost:8080/parabank 2) Enter the username and password 3) Click Log In
Expected result: Login succeeds and the Accounts Overview page opens showing john's accounts

Title: Log in with a wrong password
Preconditions: ParaBank is running on baseline data; user is logged out
Steps: 1) Open http://localhost:8080/parabank 2) Enter the username and password 3) Click Log In
Expected result: Login fails with the message "The username and password could not be verified." and the user stays logged out

Title: Log in with empty username and password
Preconditions: ParaBank is running on baseline data; user is logged out
Steps: 1) Open http://localhost:8080/parabank 2) Leave both fields empty 3) Click Log In
Expected result: Login fails, an error message is shown, and the user stays logged out (exact message to be recorded when executed)
